references.text: Jesus commands the dead man to come out of the tomb, just as he earlier commanded the stone to be removed, and the dead man comes forward with bindings on his hands and feet.
Jesus answers doubts about the condition of the body by reminding them that faith will see God's glory, even when the smell of death is present.
Martha previously expressed belief that God would give Jesus whatever he asked for, even though she did not expect a resurrection at this moment.
Jesus is deeply moved and weeps over the situation with his dead friend and the grieving family, just before he commands the stone to be removed.
